overview: The Leviathan is a interdictor-class cruiser whose service history spans Old Republic (3,956–3,951 BBY). Darth Malak's flagship during the Jedi Civil War, a Sith warship that hunted the Ebon Hawk across the Outer Rim. Imperial archives, Rebel intelligence briefings, and Mandalorian shipyard records estimate total production at ~30 Interdictor-class hulls, though wartime losses and black-market refits make exact counts difficult to verify.
history:
Design bureaus first drafted the Leviathan during the political tensions that defined Old Republic (3,956–3,951 BBY). Engineers prioritised capabilities suited to its role as a interdictor-class cruiser, balancing armour, manoeuvrability, and crew requirements against the industrial capacity of the factions that ordered it into production.

As fleet doctrine evolved, the Leviathan entered front-line service in convoy escort, planetary assault, and deep-space patrol missions. Darth Malak's flagship during the Jedi Civil War, a Sith warship that hunted the Ebon Hawk across the Outer Rim. Veterans praised its reliability under fire while analysts debated whether mass production at ~30 Interdictor-class hulls diluted quality control across shipyard lines.

Major campaigns cemented the vessel's reputation — whether as a terror weapon, a rebel lifeline, or a smuggler's last hope. Battle damage reports show the interdictor-class cruiser could absorb punishment that would destroy lighter craft, though attrition rates climbed sharply during the bloodiest years of galactic war.

In the modern era, surviving hulls appear in private collections, museum orbits, and covert fleets. Restorers hunt spare parts across scrap worlds while historians argue the Leviathan symbolises the industrial scale of conflict more than any single battle honour.
significance:
The Leviathan illustrates how shipwright traditions and wartime desperation combine to shape galactic warfare. Its interdictor-class cruiser layout influenced successor designs long after production lines fell silent.

Approximately ~30 Interdictor-class hulls hulls served during Old Republic (3,956–3,951 BBY), making the class one of the most visible symbols of its faction's naval power. Colour markings and unit insignia turned anonymous factory output into icons recognised across holonet broadcasts.

For engineers and tacticians, the Leviathan remains a case study in trade-offs between firepower, crew survival, and maintenance — lessons still taught at academies from Coruscant to Mandalore.
